name: Olympus Mons
origin: Mount Olympus, home of Greek gods; tallest planetary volcano.

name: Ascraeus Mons
origin: Northernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Pavonis Mons
origin: Central shield volcano of Tharsis Montes.

name: Arsia Mons
origin: Southernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Elysium Mons
origin: Volcanic peak in Elysium Planitia.

name: Alba Mons
origin: Broadest volcanic shield on Mars.

name: Valles Marineris
origin: Grand canyon system of Mars; Mariner 9 mission.

name: Kasei Valles
origin: Japanese word for Mars; giant outflow channel.

name: Ares Vallis
origin: Greek god of war; Pathfinder landing site.

name: Mawrth Vallis
origin: Welsh word for Mars; clay-rich ancient outflow.

name: Gale Crater
origin: Walter F. Gale, Australian astronomer; MSL Curiosity site.

name: Jezero Crater
origin: Town in Bosnia and Herzegovina; Mars 2020 Perseverance site.

name: Gusev Crater
origin: Matvey Gusev, Russian astronomer; MER Spirit site.

name: Victoria Crater
origin: Magellan's ship; explored by Opportunity rover.

name: Endeavour Crater
origin: HMS Endeavour; Opportunity rover destination.

name: Korolev Crater
origin: Sergei Korolev, Soviet rocket engineer; filled with permanent water ice.

name: Schiaparelli Crater
origin: Giovanni Schiaparelli, Italian astronomer.

name: Hellas Planitia
origin: Classical name for Greece; deepest impact basin on Mars.

name: Argyre Planitia
origin: Mythical silver island in the Indian Ocean.

name: Isidis Planitia
origin: Egyptian goddess Isis.

name: Utopia Planitia
origin: Nowhere Land; Viking 2 and Zhurong landing site.

name: Acidalia Planitia
origin: Mythological fountain of Venus.

name: Elysium Planitia
origin: Elysian Fields in Greek mythology; InSight lander site.

name: Noctis Labyrinthus
origin: Labyrinth of the night; complex valley network at western Valles Marineris.

name: Aram Chaos
origin: Biblical region; collapsed chaotic terrain rich in hematite.

name: Gorgonum Chaos
origin: Mythological Gorgons; source of recent gullies.

name: Hebes Chasma
origin: Hebes, Greek goddess of youth; closed canyon depression.

name: Melas Chasma
origin: Greek for dark; central and deepest segment of Valles Marineris.

name: Planum Boreum
origin: Northern plain; Martian north polar ice cap.

name: Planum Australe
origin: Southern plain; Martian south polar ice cap.

name: Cerberus Fossae
origin: Cerberus from Greek mythology; seismically active fissures detected by InSight.

name: Tycho Crater
origin: Tycho Brahe, Danish astronomer; prominent lunar ray crater.

name: Copernicus Crater
origin: Nicolaus Copernicus, Polish astronomer.

name: Aristarchus Crater
origin: Aristarchus of Samos; brightest feature on the lunar surface.

name: Kepler Crater
origin: Johannes Kepler, German astronomer.

name: Shackleton Crater
origin: Ernest Shackleton, Antarctic explorer; lunar south pole with permanently shadowed regions.

name: Clavius Crater
origin: Christopher Clavius, Jesuit mathematician; one of the largest lunar craters.

name: Mare Tranquillitatis
origin: Sea of Tranquility; Apollo 11 landing site.

name: Mare Imbrium
origin: Sea of Showers; vast lava-flooded impact basin.

name: Mare Serenitatis
origin: Sea of Serenity; Apollo 17 landing site nearby.

name: Oceanus Procellarum
origin: Ocean of Storms; largest lunar mare.

name: Montes Apenninus
origin: Apennine Mountains; border of Mare Imbrium; Apollo 15 landing site.
